name: Riftseeker’s Sanctum: Chamber of Storms
summary: A lightning‑charged elemental chamber where Riftseekers harness Discord‑infused storms to disrupt planar flows and energize rift conduits.
description: The Chamber of Storms is a volatile elemental hall within Riftseeker’s Sanctum. Lightning arcs between crystalline towers, thunder reverberates through the chamber, and Discord‑charged winds tear across suspended platforms. Riftseekers use this chamber to energize planar conduits and destabilize rift barriers. Muramite forces seek to weaponize the chamber’s lightning, while Discord manifestations twist the storms into chaotic bursts of destructive power. The air crackles with energy, danger, and the roar of elemental fury.
